recentItems.title: The Child | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
Mariaje and Nicasio, a mother and a grandfather whose lives were forever marked by loss, seek, each in their own way, a way to live with the memory and the pain.

Goya Award winners Belén Cuesta and Karra Elejalde star under the direction of writer-director Mariano Barroso to bring these two characters to life in a story about grief, memory, and the different ways of facing absence.

Based on the novel of the same name by Fernando Aramburu, The child is a journey of searching and resilience, filled with unexpected depths of emotion.

November 27, only on Netflix.
